step.adapter.none.detail: Windows reports no usable network adapter. Check whether a network card is installed and its driver is working.
step.adapter.disabled.detail: The adapter exists but is switched off in Windows. Enable it under Network connections.
step.link.disconnected.detail: The adapter is on but has no link. The network cable is unplugged or broken, or the device at the other end is off.
step.link.wifiNotAssociated: Not connected to a Wi-Fi network
step.link.wifiNotAssociated.detail: The Wi-Fi adapter is on but not associated with an access point. Select a network, or check that you are in range.
step.ip.none.detail: The adapter has no usable IPv4 address, so no traffic can leave this machine.
step.ip.apipa.detail: This is an automatic fallback address Windows assigns itself when no DHCP server answers. Your router most likely did not hand out an address.
step.gateway.none.detail: No default gateway is configured, so nothing outside your own subnet can be reached.
step.gateway.unreachable.detail: Your router did not answer a ping or a connection attempt. It may be restarting, or something between you and it is blocking traffic.
step.publicIp.none.detail: None of the public test addresses answered. Either the connection is down, or this network blocks ping traffic.
step.dns.slow: Name resolution is slower than usual.
step.dns.failed.detail: Neither your own DNS server nor the public test resolvers answered, which points at the connection rather than at DNS itself.
step.dns.ownResolverFailed: Your DNS server is not answering
step.dns.ownResolverFailed.detail: Public resolvers answered the same question without trouble, so the problem is the DNS server this machine is configured to use.
step.target.allFailed: None of the {0} targets are reachable
step.target.serverError.detail: The server answered, but with an error - the connection is fine, the service is not.
step.latency.high: Response times are higher than usual.
step.simulated.detail: This step was forced to fail by the fault simulator. Nothing is actually wrong with it.
